# Claude Code 2.1.278 identity

Frozen against npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.278` and GitHub
`v2.1.278`. Every published stable between the qualified `2.1.270` ceiling
and official `2.1.278` was retrieved and classified: `2.1.271`, `2.1.272`,
`2.1.273`, `2.1.274`, `2.1.275`, `2.1.276`, `2.1.277`, and `2.1.278`. No
unpublished gap exists inside this hop window. First unpublished later
stable at observation: `2.1.279`.

Host `claude` was not on `PATH`. Missing host install is not a gap and was
not installed. Downloaded official `2.1.270` through `2.1.278` binaries
were hashed and never executed.

Wrapper installer files except `package.json` and `sdk-tools.d.ts` are
byte-identical across all nine compared versions. Selected mapped headless
and response-only flags, format choices, effort and permission enumerations,
and the stream-JSON init/result/stream-event/hook/thinking-tokens shapes
stay. `--verbose`, `--model`, and `--effort` carry hop-local bunfs-chunk or
minified-template remangles that do not change selected help or choices.
`dist-inventory.json` freezes hop-by-hop wrapper and platform-package file
counts, exact added/removed/changed/identical sets, tarball and binary
digests, and npm/GitHub publication identity.

`identity.json` and `protocol.json` record the headless axis.
`response-only.json` records the separate response-only axis. Neither
replaces the `claude-code-2.1.220` headless decoder specimen, the
`2.1.227`/`2.1.228` response-only specimens, nor the frozen `2.1.234`/
`2.1.235`/`2.1.238`/`2.1.241`/`2.1.251`/`2.1.252`/`2.1.257`/`2.1.270`
corpora. Maximum-turn and other feature-specific exact version sets stay on
the `2.1.220..=2.1.241` probed sets.

Watcher help/digest stays on exact `2.1.251`; this family does not copy those
fixtures, does not raise `CLAUDE_CODE_WATCHER_VERSION`, and does not widen
watcher help, digest, or live authorization. No provider prompt was sent.
